text:
Maya: ok tiny idea: mezz mini "Night Olympics" tonight. 3 quick events: 1) Smash 1v1 bracket, 2) Rocket League 2v2 rotation, 3) Arcade speedrun (highest score). winner gets the illustrious plastic banana trophy. whos in? :banana:
Nate: love it. count me for Smash and RL. can someone run brackets?
Owen: i'll do brackets. can set up a simple single-elim; losers play for 3rd. ill post a link with match order.
Felix: bringing my Switch, 2 pro controllers, and a tiny Bluetooth speaker. also can mic up for shoutcasting if needed. :microphone:
Tara: snacks? i'm bringing homemade brownies (vegan option). also bringing spare AA batteries for any remotes.
Maya: awesome. projector's batteries low last time so thanks for AA heads-up.
Nate: timeline idea: 8:00 warm-up / set-up, 8:30 brackets start, 10:30 finals and arcade showdown. ok?
Owen: perfect. i'll create the bracket sheet here: https://tiny/redwood-bracket (placeholder).
Felix: quick ask: anyone allergic to peanuts? brownies have no peanuts but want to label.
Tara: no peanut allergies in my fam, but let's label anyway.
Maya: sign-up quick list: Smash (1v1) spots open x8; RL needs 4 players (two teams) but we can rotate. Arcade is open. post your name + event combo.
Nate: Smash: Nate
Owen: Smash: Owen
Felix: Smash: Felix; RL: Felix + Nate
Tara: Arcade + snacks
Maya: Smash: Maya; RL: Maya + ??? (need partner)
Felix: @Maya i'll team up with you for RL.
Owen: heads up: bring headphones if youre sensitive to shoutcasting. we try to keep volume friendly.
announce-bot: event created: "Mezz Night Olympics" at 2024-07-22T20:30:00Z.
Tara: also quick logistics: couch seats 4; bring folding chairs if you want guaranteed seating.
Nate: i can bring 1 folding chair and a table for brackets/scorekeeping.
Maya: small rules: Smash best-of-3 until semis (best-of-5), items off, final destination/neutral picks allowed per the house rules ill paste below:
Maya: ```house rules:
- Controllers plugged in first > press sync to avoid match delays
- Stage bans: 1 ban each, winner picks
- Pause penalty: 30s to rematch or forfeit round
```
Owen: will screen-share the bracket and update live. if someone wants to stream highlights later record locally; office Wi-Fi blocks outbound streaming.
Felix: prize update: loser of final has to wear the banana on camera for team photo. champion gets bragging rights + banana.
Tara: bring a small plate and napkins for brownies, i'll label vegan.
Nate: shoutcasting order: Felix then Owen for semis, ill do finals if needed.
Maya: last-minute: who can bring ethernet cable? wireless might be flaky for Rocket League.
Owen: i have a 10ft cat6, leaving it on the mezz table.
Felix: i'll tape a small sticky note on the projector remote this time so it doesn't vanish. learned that from last week. :laughing:
Maya: great. see yall 8:00 for setup, 8:30 events. bring enthusiasm + comfy socks. :socks:
Tara: see you! brownies secured. :brownie:
